Title: Anil and the Family

Cast

1. Anil - 33 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Neeta - 55 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line
3. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The living room - Night

[Anil stands in the living room. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "It's very late tonight."

[Anil lights the oil lamp in the dark room.]

Anil: "One more time!"

[Anil blows out the lamp and goes to sleep.]

Anil: "How beautiful!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Anil stands in the living room. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "Look over here."

[Anil pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Anil: "Show me too!"

[Anil sips red wine.]

Neeta: "Okay, Anil."

[Anil drinks a beer.]

Anil: "One more time!"

[Anil staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Anil (surprised): "That's easy."

[Anil and Mother clink their glasses.]

Anil: "That's great!"

Scene 3: The terrace - Day

Neeta: "What a nice place."

[Anil ties a letter to the pigeon and lets it fly.]

Anil: "Well done!"

[Anil reads the letter the pigeon brought.]

Neeta (surprised): "Anil, look at this."

Scene 4: The bathroom - Day

[Anil stands in the bathroom. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "What a nice place."

[Anil shaves in front of the mirror.]

Anil: "That was such a fun day!"
